display: Searched 207 files for 'createClient|createPromiseClient|createGrpcWebTransport|createConnectTransport' — 13 matches in 1 files

content:
q07. `web/src/connect.ts`

This file creates all ConnectRPC service clients (e.g., `instanceServiceClient`, `authServiceClient`, `userServiceClient`, `memoServiceClient`, etc.) using `createClient` from `@connectrpc/connect` with a transport created via `createConnectTransport` from `@connectrpc/connect-web`.
